description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Senior Manager, Enterprise Application Development Engineering, you’ll lead the team that builds and runs GitLab’s internal applications. You’ll report to the Senior Director, Enterprise AI, and lead a team growing to seven engineers across the US, EMEA and India. The work is highly cross-functional: your partners span go-to-market, Finance, People, R&D, Data & Insights and more, often with competing priorities.

This is a leadership role, not a hands-on coding role. You’ll own the technical direction and the team’s standards and working practices, and spend most of your time developing engineers and making sure the team delivers at pace while holding a very high bar for quality. Hiring will be a big focus early on as the team grows.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the team. Coach and grow engineers across time zones, with clear expectations, useful feedback and async practices that hold up, and hire well as the team grows.
  • Own the technical direction and quality bar. This is an AI-native team: agents write most of the code, and engineers set the direction and own the result. You’ll review designs and architecture, set the standards for testing, code review, CI/CD and releases, and be accountable for everything the team ships meeting a high bar for quality, however much of it AI wrote.
  • Shape what gets built. Each application has a named business owner who owns the outcome; you own how it’s built and run. Decide with them whether to build, buy, configure or extend, weighing cost, expected return and long-term ownership.
  • Manage delivery across the portfolio. Turn priorities into achievable plans, make trade-offs visible and balance new work with maintenance and support.
  • Work as one team with AI Engineering. Application development and AI engineering are one Enterprise AI team with different focus areas. Decide together whether a problem needs an app, an agent or a skill.
  • Protect sensitive data. Several applications hold people and financial data. Work with Security, Privacy and Legal on access, data protection reviews and works council requirements.
  • Own each application for its whole life. Make sure each one has an owner, monitoring, support and a known cost to run, and consolidate or retire it when it stops earning its keep.
  • Measure what matters. Track idea-to-production time, user satisfaction (CSAT) and cost to run against value.

What you’ll bring

  • Several years managing software engineering teams, including senior engineers, with a record of hiring and developing people.
  • A background building and running production software across the stack, including data and integrations, so you can engage credibly with the technical detail.
  • Sound engineering and product judgment: you know when an approach needs to change and where custom software is justified.
  • Experience leading a distributed team across time zones in a highly cross-functional, remote and asynchronous setting.
  • Experience leading AI-native development, where agents write most of the code, and the judgment to keep quality high as output grows.
  • Strong communication with technical and non-technical partners.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading a portfolio of internal business applications.
  • Experience with GitLab, CI/CD and data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Experience with applications that handle sensitive people or financial data.

About the team

Enterprise Application Development sits within Enterprise AI in GitLab’s Enterprise Technology & AI organization. Application development and AI engineering work as one team, alongside Data & Insights and partners across the business, guided by GitLab’s operating principles: Speed with Quality, Ownership Mindset and Customer Outcomes, built on a Culture of Excellence.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range
$168,000—$285,600 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
